pdo.duty: Range officer over Brass Lantern. The gunnery moon is hot. Hail a keel that crowds the watch. Guns wait for the slate.

scale_clerk.duty: Scale Clerk at Brass Lantern. Honest scales. Fuel and ammo are weighed in public. Come alongside and the clerk reads the hold.

pdo.duty: Bailiff over Writ. Seized hulls stay on the slate. Hail a keel in the yard. The tow to Gyre is the next paper.

bailiff_holt.duty: Bailiff Holt at Writ. Walk the seized yard and name the next tow to Gyre.

pdo.duty: Cadet watch over White Wake. Hail paint rounds before live guns. The green still writes a shot.
Patrol over Ledger. Hail a keel that closes inside 640 meters. Guns follow the slate, not the first look.

bond_factor.duty: Bond Factor at Ledger. Orbit the yard. Come alongside and the paper is read in public.

pdo.duty: Patrol over Quiet Sun. Hail a keel that closes inside 640 meters. Guns follow the slate, not the first look.

porch_hauler.duty: Porch Hauler at Quiet Sun. Orbit the suburb lamp. The amber work is the buoy gyre behind the porch, not the green lane.

tally_clerk.duty: Tally Clerk at Lease. Sell the harvest paper. Tallyrock is mined out and the license is still for sale.

paper_vendor.duty: Paper Vendor at Lease. A second copy of the harvest paper. Come alongside and read the fine print before you cut.

tug_factor.duty: Tug Factor at Towline. Hold the tow. Inside 480 meters, match the captain's nose and stay on the road.

choir_hauler.duty: Choir Hauler at Ore Choir. Haul metal off the belt. The claim jumper on the rim wants the same load.

pirates.duty: Claim jumper over Ore Choir. Sit the pocket. Chase a keel that enters it. Stay put while the pocket is empty.
Kite over Ore Choir. Hold 340 to 460 meters, slide the flank, and shoot. Do not sit in the guns.

weather_shepherd.duty: Weather Shepherd at Two Weathers. Walk the terminator pocket. Ember kale wants the hot face. Ghost gourd wants the cold.

stamp_clerk.duty: Stamp Clerk at Broken Charter. Orbit the yard. Come alongside and the paper is read in public.

pirates.duty: Ambush over Broken Charter. Hold the home buoy. Close only when a keel comes inside 520 meters or shoots.

pirates.duty: Kite over Stamped Ice. Hold 340 to 460 meters off the clock ring and shoot from the flank. Do not sit in the ice.

pdo.duty: Print clerk over Second Copy. The stencil is the law. Hail a keel that enters the bay.

pirates.duty: Ambush over Second Copy. Hold the bad copies until a keel comes inside 520 meters, then close.

pirates.duty: Ambush over Fine Print. Hold the school buoy. Close when a keel enters 520 meters.
Kite over Fine Print. Keep the flank at 340 to 460 meters and punish a straight run.
Raider over Fine Print. Take the clerk's hull first. The captain is the second prize.
